title: Inu x Boku SS Special
justification: AniList 13403 is one special, 2012-09-26, offline-database title 'Inu x Boku SS: Miketsukami-kun Henka/Switch/Omamagoto'. AniDB 8564 S1 is 'Miketsukami-kun Henka / Switch / Omamagoto' (2012-09-26); TVDB 255133 0x01 is "Miketsukami-kun's Transformations / Switch / Playing House" on 2012-09-26, the only special. The AniList English title says 'Special' only; the content is the same single OVA.
